<thought>To provide a valid retrosynthetic route, I will first locate a template that transforms a β‑silyl ketone into the target diaryl alkene via a Peterson elimination. I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a C‑C double bond and form a ketone (the trimethylsilyl group is also formed, but the primary functional change is the creation of a carbonyl). Once a suitable template is found, I will apply it to the target molecule to obtain the precursor SMILES, verify the step, and then construct the required JSON route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
  "limit": 10
}</action_input>
